window.__haugastolConsentState = { analytics: false, marketing: false };
window.gtag = window.gtag || function(){window.dataLayer.push(arguments);};
window.gtag('consent', 'default', {
  'analytics_storage': 'denied',
  'ad_storage': 'denied',
  'ad_user_data': 'denied',
  'ad_personalization': 'denied',
  'wait_for_update': 500
});
window.dataLayer.push({ event: 'consent_default_denied' });
(function(){
  function clearCookies(prefixes) {
    var hostname = window.location.hostname;
    var labels = hostname.split('.');
    var parentDomain = labels.length > 2 ? '.' + labels.slice(-2).join('.') : '';
    var domains = ['', hostname, '.' + hostname, parentDomain];
    var names = document.cookie.split(';').map(function(part) {
      return decodeURIComponent((part.split('=')[0] || '').trim());
    });
    names.forEach(function(name) {
      if (!name || !prefixes.some(function(prefix) {
        return name === prefix || name.indexOf(prefix) === 0;
      })) return;
      domains.forEach(function(domain) {
        var domainPart = domain ? '; Domain=' + domain : '';
        document.cookie = encodeURIComponent(name) + '=; Max-Age=0; Path=/' + domainPart + '; SameSite=Lax';
      });
    });
  }
  try {
    var raw = window.localStorage.getItem("haugastol_consent_v2");
    if (!raw) return;
    var stored = JSON.parse(raw);
    var valid =
      stored &&
      stored.version === 2 &&
      stored.policyVersion === "2026-10-05" &&
      stored.copyVersion === "2026-10-05" &&
      typeof stored.receiptId === 'string' &&
      stored.receiptId.length >= 16 &&
      typeof stored.createdAt === 'number' &&
      Number.isFinite(stored.createdAt) &&
      typeof stored.updatedAt === 'number' &&
      Number.isFinite(stored.updatedAt) &&
      typeof stored.expiresAt === 'number' &&
      Number.isFinite(stored.expiresAt) &&
      stored.expiresAt > Date.now() &&
      stored.necessary === true &&
      typeof stored.analytics === 'boolean' &&
      typeof stored.marketing === 'boolean';
    if (!valid) {
      window.localStorage.removeItem("haugastol_consent_v2");
      return;
    }
    if (!stored.analytics) clearCookies(['_ga', '_gid', '_gat']);
    if (!stored.marketing) clearCookies(['_gcl_', '_gac_', '_fbp', '_fbc']);
    var restored = {
      analytics_storage: stored.analytics ? 'granted' : 'denied',
      ad_storage: stored.marketing ? 'granted' : 'denied',
      ad_user_data: stored.marketing ? 'granted' : 'denied',
      ad_personalization: stored.marketing ? 'granted' : 'denied'
    };
    window.__haugastolConsentState = {
      analytics: stored.analytics,
      marketing: stored.marketing
    };
    window.gtag('consent', 'update', restored);
    window.dataLayer.push({
      event: 'consent_restored',
      consent_analytics: stored.analytics,
      consent_marketing: stored.marketing,
      consent_version: 'v2'
    });
  } catch (_) {}

several options of high-quality accommodation – from private apartments for 1–8 guests to a shared mountain room for those who want a more affordable alternative. Our accommodation works well for both short stays and longer trips, and provides an easy base for activities all year.</p></div></div></section><section id="romtyper" aria-labelledby="room-selector-title" class="scroll-mt-24 bg-[#e7e3d9] py-20 md:py-28"><div class="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1440px] px-5 sm:px-8 lg:px-10"><p class="text-[0.65rem] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#4f5853]">Find your room</p><div class="mt-4 grid gap-7 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_420px] lg:items-end"><h2 id="room-selector-title" class="font-serif text-5xl font-medium leading-[0.9] tracking-[-0.04em] md:text-7xl">Four ways to stay at Haugastøl.</h2><p class="text-base leading-7 text-[#46534d]">From a compact apartment for two to space for the whole group. NRK channels are available without signing in. Want other channels, such as TV 2 or streaming services you use at home? Simply log in with your own subscription in the app – just like at home.</p></div><div class="bg-[#faf8f4] p-7 md:p-10"><p class="text-[0.62rem] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-[#4f5853]">Good to know</p><h3 class="mt-4 font-serif text-4xl font-medium leading-[0.95]">Dogs in apartment</h3><p class="mt-6 leading-7 text-[#46534d]">Dogs are allowed in some apartments for a fee of NOK 350. We have a limited number of each type that allow dogs; availability must be confirmed before booking (call or email).</p><ul class="mt-6 space-y-3 border-t border-[#10261f]/15 pt-5 text-sm leading-6 text-[#46534d]"><li class="flex gap-3"><span aria-hidden="true" class="text-[#c94839]">—</span>Dogs may not lie on sofas, chairs or beds.</li><li class="flex gap-3"><span aria-hidden="true" class="text-[#c94839]">—</span>Dogs may not be left alone in the apartment unless in a crate.</li><li class="flex gap-3"><span aria-hidden="true" class="text-[#c94839]">—</span>Dogs are not allowed in the restaurant or common areas.</li></ul></div></div><section class="border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-[#faf8f3] p-5 md:p-6 mt-px !border-[#10261f]/15 !bg-[#faf8f4] md:!p-10"><p class="text-[0.68rem] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-[#6a645d]">Good to know</p><h2 class="mt-2 text-3xl font-medium text-[#1d1916] md:text-4xl">Two operating modes</h2><ul class="mt-3 space-y-1 text-[#4a453f]"><li>In some periods we run with full service (reception, restaurant/meals and common areas).</li><li>In shoulder season (20 September to the start of February 2027) we run self-service: apartment with kitchen and self check-in. Reception, restaurant, sauna and other common areas are then closed.</li><li>What applies to your dates is always shown in the booking flow.</li><li>Bike packages are only available during full service periods.</li></ul><div class="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3"><a href="https://app.mews.com/distributor/23d997cf-d336-457d-95af-b3f100d6ea16?language=en-US&amp;src_engine=accommodation&amp;src_interest=accommodation&amp;src_page=%2Fen%2Faccommodation" class="booking-cta-on-light inline-block border border-[#1d1916] bg-[#1d1916] px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-white" style="color:#fff" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Go to booking</a><a class="inline-block border border-[#1d1916] bg-white px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[#1d1916]" style="color:#1d1916" href="/en/self-service">About self-service stays</a></div><p class="mt-3 text-sm text-[#4a453f]">Nearest grocery store: Ustaoset (13 km east).
